summary: Workspace CI routes twelve tiny control and evidence job definitions to the existing owned priority role only for trusted merge-group and protected-main push events, avoiding nine of fourteen initial hosted dispatches in the sampled merge run. Every PR remains hosted for these controls. Check names, dependencies and validation are unchanged; no metered capacity is added.

compatibility.detail: Required check names and semantics are unchanged. Every PR, including forks and same-repository heads, retains hosted control jobs; real toolchain work, bootstrap selection and queue observation retain their existing placement.

downtime.detail: New workflow runs use the changed labels; existing runs retain their placement.

manual.detail: Uses the existing owned priority role; no provisioning, subscription or variable change.

recovery.detail: Revert the workflow source and regenerate.
